basic_info.description: With easy access to the best of Noe Valley and the vibrant Mission, this bright, chic home offers a light-filled open-floor plan with a flow that is ideal for modern living. Entering the bright living room, the spaciousness is apparent as you look to the open dining area. A breakfast bar, the perfect place for morning coffee, separates the kitchen and dining room. The updated kitchen is flooded with light from the skylight above. It boasts stainless steel appliances, ample counter space and storage and is sure to please the most accomplished home chef. The living room, with a wood burning fireplace, has views of Bernal Heights, with the charm of an adjacent cozy den. A full bath is located off the hall leading to the two comfortable bedrooms. The tranquil primary bedroom has a stylish en-suite bath, and the second bedroom offers direct access to the sheltered back yard. The private yard has a bar with built-in tv, all designed for outdoor living and entertaining. On the lower level you find a one-car garage and bonus space with a convenient laundry area. With a Walker's & Biker's Paradise Score of 96, excellent Transit rating and near tech shuttle stops the convenience is exceptional.  This is a rarely available opportunity to own a single-family home in the heart of the city.
